persona.brief:
On a real call to the studio you said:
- "Hi, it's Meenal. I wanted to speak to Rohan about my kitchen — the tile samples."
Phone: you're calling from your own mobile.
persona.behaviour: You're Meenal, an existing client (your 2BHK kitchen in Baner is being done by Aangan). You want to speak to your designer Rohan about the tile samples he sent. It's not a complaint. If asked when he should call: 'today after 6 pm'. Keep it short.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Meenal! What can I help you with today — a new project, something about an existing project, or reaching a particular designer?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I wanted to speak to Rohan about my kitchen — the tile samples.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: When are you generally free to take a call, Meenal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'll pass your message about the kitchen tile samples to Rohan and make sure he gets back to you as soon as possible — we've noted you're free today after 6 pm. Have a good day!

reasons: Not yet clear the caller wants design and execution

message.about: Meenal wants to speak with Rohan regarding kitchen tile samples.

ask_next: Ask for the locality and PIN code (to confirm coverage and match a nearby designer).
Ask one direct question: do they want design AND execution, or advice/ideas only?
result.next_question: What would you like done — which rooms or areas, and are you looking for full design and execution?
still_missing: Size of the area to be done
result.note: Keep collecting. Don't decline. If still unclear at the end, a designer will confirm fit and call back.
